name: scalino
description: JVM-free Scala language server (scalino-lsp, from scalino) -- diagnostics and hover without Metals' JVM dependency.

scalino.path.description: Absolute path to the scalino-lsp binary (dist/scalino-lsp). Falls back to PATH lookup if unset.

scalino.env.description: Extra environment variables for the scalino-lsp process.

scalino.initializationOptions.description: Extra LSP initializationOptions passed to scalino-lsp on initialize.

scalino.trace.server.description: Trace LSP communication between VS Code and scalino-lsp.

scalino.inlayHints.typeParameters.enable.description: Show inferred type arguments of method calls.

scalino.inlayHints.implicitArguments.ena.description: Show implicit/given arguments passed to method calls.

scalino.inlayHints.implicitConversions.e.description: Show implicit conversions applied to expressions.

scalino.inlayHints.byNameParameters.enab.description: Show by-name parameter markers (`=>`) on call arguments.

scalino.inlayHints.namedParameters.enabl.description: Show parameter names on call arguments.

scalino.inlayHints.hintsInPatternMatch.e.description: Show inferred types in pattern matches.
